0022600198.text: The Utah Jazz (1-8, on a seven-game losing streak and 0-4 on the road) visit the Minnesota Timberwolves (7-3, on a three-game winning streak) in the Jazz's 10th game of the season, with Utah 14th in the West and Minnesota 6th. Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee) and Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), while Minnesota is missing Anthony Edwards (knee surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery) and Terrence Shannon Jr. (hip bruise), and Joan Beringer is day-to-day with a fracture and a game-time decision. Minnesota won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 147-111 win in Minneapolis on March 18, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 season series.
